text_block_list.text:
On my way back from the Gold Class info 
session, I found a Trainer's notebook 
dropped on the ground.

"Inside, details about the owner's trainee 
Umamusume were written down meticulously."

Not just her daily training menu, but her 
love for aquariums, her favorite shops, 
recreated recipes...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Good work, Meek. Let's call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Today's meal. What... do you want to 
eat?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Looking at Meek's recent meal 
plan, she seems to be slightly lacking in 
dietary fats, so—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Shall we build the training menu around 
that?"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Of course, we'll add Meek's favorites 
too.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Enjoying what you eat is just as 
important as nutritional balance, after 
all!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Then please go change before you catch a 
chill. I will join you shortly.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
choice_data_list: Good work out there, Trainer Kiryuin.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer <username>! Thanks for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I heard the news! I understand <chrname>-san has 
reached the Gold Class as well!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, me too. Fufu, it's quite an 
honor that it happened around the same 
time!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I still have much to learn. I 
intend to continue striving diligently 
from here on out.

Since Happy Meek reached the Gold Class as 
well, Trainer Kiryuin must have attended 
the briefing earlier today too.

Thinking it would be best given the 
situation, I took out my Trainer's 
notebook and showed it to her.
choice_data_list: Does this notebook look familiar to you?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah... T-That's—!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...! I couldn't find it 
anywhere after coming back from the 
briefing, so I was really in a bind.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
To think I dropped it on the way home... 
How truly embarrassing.

I explained that I deduced the owner's 
identity from the passionate notes written 
inside.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It is all thanks to the advice you 
gave me.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Every time I learn something new about 
Meek, I get so happy that I end up writing 
pages and pages.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...However...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Ah... N-No! Sorry, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, training's over, time to pack up, 
pack up!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer <username>, I shall take my 
leave.

Though she abruptly cut the conversation 
short, Trainer Kiryuin's demeanor left me 
somewhat concerned.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Why is Bitter Glas struggling to improve 
so much...?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...There shouldn't be any issues with the 
training menu."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Because the Kiryuin family predecessors 
have always achieved results using 
regimens based on the "Trainer's White 
Paper."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"The 'White Paper' is the crystallization 
of the wisdom of everyone who has raised 
generations of GⅠ Umamusume and Hall of 
Fame Umamusume...!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
There isn't a single thing wrong with Meek 
either... She has plenty of motivation, 
and more than enough ability...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Then what's missing is—
